scope: Independent read-only audit of the preserved first outcome. This receipt records the already completed audit; no additional evaluation was run when writing it.
audit_method: Read the preregistered protocol, runner, generator, freeze, run claim, saved observations, saved parser outputs and first results; did not import or execute any product parser or optical worker.

Recomputed mandatory-field classifications independently in Python from saved parser values against frozen gold, using the preregistered exact normalization rules. Checked each field, each case, both engines and every reported population.
Verified all 19 frozen file hashes both on disk and in the preregistration Git commit, plus all 54 hashes in the completed artifact manifest.
Verified freeze before preregistration commit before run claim before result; checked approved-source Git differences, recorded source/model hashes and the reused installation's matching lockfile.

Checked the 84 recorded call events: one sequential worker attempt and one Node plus one Sites parser call for each of the 14 images. Checked actual image hashes against saved observation input hashes.

Independently checked organization-number format/checksum, SEK currency, exact integer monetary arithmetic and 30-day due dates for all 14 gold records. Checked six Swedish and six English normal documents with two of each of three layouts per language.
Compared saved Node/Sites results: all fields, issues, confidence and levels agree; only extracted_at differs. Checked explicit direction metadata separately from image fields.
limitations: Fourteen optical observations feed twenty-eight parser calls; the two engines are not independent optical populations and are not pooled.
Direction is explicitly supplied metadata, not an image-recognized field. The primary normal denominator is 12 times nine, not ten, fields.
Observed mandatory-field precision 62/62 does not establish population precision of at least 98 percent or complete extraction. Recall fails the joint 85/98 target.
Zero false greens with zero green documents supplies no positive sample from which to estimate green-result correctness.
Twelve normal synthetic invoices, three layout families, one recipient and one VAT rate are a narrow controlled cohort; correlated templates are not independent population sampling.
Valid organization-number syntax/checksum is not registry verification. No real business identity or banking authorization follows.
Artifact integrity and recorded chronology are checked. The evaluator's claimed prior blindness and absence of all unrecorded executions cannot be independently established from artifacts alone.

This review did not perform a new visual readability certification. It inspected the frozen generator and gold and verified exact image hashes; the original evaluator's visual QA remains separately attributed.
The earlier independent cohort remains a separate preserved first outcome. Different cohorts do not establish that the later worker change caused the difference in worker failures or recall.
finding: No concrete method, arithmetic or recorded-provenance error found within this scope. The first outcome is preserved and the joint quality target remains unmet.
